name: Skin and Soul Sanctuary
sub: Advanced esthetics and soul services with Christine Byrnes

hero.alt: The private atelier at Skin and Soul Sanctuary with cream chairs, a white table and roses

intro.text: Skin & Soul Sanctuary is Christine Byrnes's private atelier in Stony Brook. A Licensed Esthetician and educator with nearly 20 years in beauty and wellness, she builds every facial around your skin after a conversation about your concerns and goals. The Sanctuary also offers a second path, Soul services, with coaching, hypnotherapy, astrology and Human Design readings, in person or over Zoom or FaceTime.
intro.quote: An Esthetician that is knowledgeable, incredible at what she does, and tailors skin regiment to meet your needs and budget.
intro.by: Dawn M., client review on skinandsoulsanctuary.com

items.d: Personalized esthetics for your skin and your goals, planned after a one-on-one consult.
b: Healthy aging, acne and sensitive skin care

items.d: Sessions for self-discovery and personal growth, in person or over Zoom or FaceTime.
b: Hypnotherapy, inner child work and past life regression

items.d: Massage and facial combinations for one, or for two with your partner or a spa buddy.
b: Red light therapy or infrared sauna add-on

items.d: Gift certificates are available for skin, soul and body services.

advantage.text: Christine was introduced to skincare by her grandmother, also an esthetician. She later became a Northeast regional trainer for DiamondTome Microdermabrasion and Clareblend microcurrent, and placed Top 10 in Age Management in the international Skin Games case study competition. She is Board Certified by the Association for Integrative Psychology as a Master Practitioner of NLP, Hypnotherapy and Mental and Emotional Release Therapy.

reviews.text: Visited the Sanctuary? A quick review helps your neighbors find Christine.

faq: Call Christine at 631-371-6192 or fill out the form on her website. She responds to all inquiries within 24 hours.
Can I do soul services remotely?
Yes. All Soul services are offered in person or over Zoom or FaceTime.
Can I book just a massage?
Massage is offered as part of a massage and facial combination. Massage-only appointments are not available at this location.

final.t: Begin with a facial or a *deeper soul session.*
final.text: Call Christine or request an appointment online.

compliance: General info, not medical advice. Services and results vary by person. Soul services are offered for personal growth and are not a substitute for medical or mental health care.
